businessProblem: The generic RM1 control-plane source-disposition template hardcodes CP-U00 anchors. That allows a subsequent control package to mechanically pass while naming a different package's manifest unit and amendment heading. The template must derive its anchors from the active package binding so an exit proves its own scope rather than a historical control package.
